description: As step-order-conditions-written, on a competing route that only the check of elision-only takes: x reads the synthetic T. The `$` condition, written first, fails, so the failing capture condition never runs, and the check passes (engine §4, §7.7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T]
%rule b A [+T] [+T]
%rule c A x
%rule x $y(T)
%conditions text($) = "q", ~z ⊆ tag(text(tail($y)))
